title: Ôn luyện Từ vựng thi vào 10 số 66: Planet Earth (Set 3)

lessons.title: nhúng từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng học các từ vựng thuộc chủ điểm Planet Earth (Set 3) ngay nhé!


Nhấn ᐸ / ᐳ để chuyển sang từ khác và 🔊 để nghe phát âm.

Bạn nên đọc kĩ nghĩa, ví dụ và nghe phát âm của tất cả các từ vựng trước khi nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang luyện tập ở mức nhận biết.

lessons.title: học từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng luyện tập các từ vựng bạn vừa học nhé!

(Nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang các bài tập tiếp theo.)

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng chủ điểm Planet Earth (Set 3)
vocabTable.example: Drag and drop to complete the passage. One of the biggest challenges for our planet today is 14.1 . It has serious 14.2  on the environment. Rising temperatures, melting ice, and changing weather patterns are just a few examples of how our world is being affected. Many animals and plants are struggling to survive because their homes are disappearing or changing. Some species are at risk of disappearing entirely. Humans are the ones who 14.3 the environment by causing pollution, cutting down forests, and burning fossil fuels. It is important for people to 14.4 their lifestyles to help protect the Earth. Simple actions, like using less plastic, planting trees, and saving energy, can make a big difference. Everyone needs to work together make Earth a better place for future generations.

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng chủ điểm Planet Earth (Set 3)
vocabTable.example: Reorder the letters to make complete words. The first letters are underlined. Anna: Mark, have you ever thought about studying 13.1 (O-Y-L- G -O-G-E) ? It helps us understand how things on Earth were formed. Mark: That sounds interesting! Why is it so important? Anna: Well, it’s 13.2 (L-T- V -A-I) because everything on Earth, even the smallest rocks, tells us about the planet’s history. Mark: Wow, I never thought about it that way. So, even tiny things on the 13.3 (F- S -C-R-E-U-A) play a role? Anna: Yes! Over time, those small things have formed 13.4 (T- G -A-I-N) mountains, valleys, and oceans. Mark: That’s amazing! I didn’t realize how everything is connected.

vocabTable.example: Read the following leaflet and choose the option that best fits each blank. Protect Wildlife – Join Our Program! Are you passionate about wildlife and nature? Our program is dedicated to protecting animals and their habitats. By learning how we can reduce pollution and use resources wisely, we can help create a safer environment for all living things. Did You Know? 🐾 Animals play a crucial role in the 15.1 economy solar system global warming food chain , maintaining balance in ecosystems. Without them, the survival of many species would be at risk. 🦎 15.2 Reptiles Insects Mammals Cattle , such as snakes, lizards, and turtles, help control pest populations and support ecosystems. 🌊 8 million tons of plastic enter the ocean every year, which harms marine life and ecosystems. 🌱 70% of species live in forests, yet forests are being lost at a rate of 10 million hectares per year. What We Provide? 🌱 We teach how to use 15.3 fertilizer power energy data  wisely to maintain healthy soil and support plant growth, which animals depend on for food. 🌍 We give you some 15.4 difficult demanding inefficient fascinating and easy-to-do ways to recycle waste, helping create a cleaner environment where animals can thrive. Join us to understand nature’s 15.5 protest significance belief bullying  and support our efforts to keep Earth a safe place for all living things. Together, we can make a difference!
